rationale_bullets: Avery Johnson (74.8/391) returns for year three: single-season school records of 25 pass TD and 605 QB rush yards, tied the career pass-TD record (48) - but boom-or-bust efficiency (58.3%, #9/#11 in B12 rating).
The reunion is the story: Klein recruited him, coached his first starts as '23 OC, and Johnson 'wanted to play in Klein's offense' (P6); the downhill-power scheme fits the run threat.
Blake Barnett = 'similar skill set and even stronger arm' (PS) behind him.
60 = above average: proven dual-threat volume + scheme/coach fit, held out of the 65+ tier by the accuracy record.
data_gaps: Accuracy ceiling in a new install

rationale_bullets: Joe Jackson (67.2/254) returns off 911 at 5.4 with the school-record 293 vs Utah; the late-'25 surge (plus 142 vs Colorado) is the verified form.
Rodney Fields Jr. (75.4/156) arrives from Oklahoma State - 614 at 5.0 plus 276 receiving, 'arguably [OkSt's] best player' (P6) - and Jay Harris (Oregon) adds depth.
As-played 7th pctile was an injury/committee artifact (Edwards hurt on his first touch, since -> Kansas); the 2026 duo is tape-real. 52 = average-plus.
The TE pair carries it: Garrett Oakley (72.2/233, school record holder) + former 5-star Linkon Cure = 'one of the best TE pairs in the B12' (P6).
The WR room thinned: Jayce Brown (75.0/243; 712 @ 17.4) -> LSU and Bradley graduated; Jaron Tibbs (68.5/336; 595 @ 12.7) is the lone returning WR starter.

Adds are projection: Brandon White (60.1/341, Hawaii starter) is the only 2025 tape; Joshua Manning (Johnson connection, 'could be the surprise breakout' - P6) and Izaiah Williams are no-tape former 4-stars.
52 = average-plus on the TE strength; WR2+ is unproven.

Four of five starters gone (46 starts): 1st-team B12 C Sam Hecht (80.3/759, #5 in PS's draft-capital ranks), Andrew Leingang (65.3/692), Taylor Poitier (66.3/658), JB Nelson - from an 87th-pctile as-played line.
John Pastore (76.2/715) is the anchor - best returning grade on the roster - with injury-returns George Fitzpatrick (ex-Ohio State, missed '25) and Gus Hawkins.
The interior is a three-way 3-star-transfer battle (Tanner Morley 66.3/252, Delvin Morris 56.7/472, Keiton Jones 8 snaps); PS: they 'figure to take a step back'; Klein 'not worried' (attributed).
44 = fringe-below-average: one proven piece plus projection.
Seven linemen gone (48 starts/142 tackles/17.5 sacks): Stufflebean/Ilalio/Seumalo expired; edges Tobi Osunsanmi and Chiddi Obiazor (68.6/497) BOTH -> Indiana.

The reload leads with two premium edges: Wendell Gregory (71.4/419) - PS's B12 Defensive Newcomer of the Year at Oklahoma State, 'best Oklahoma State defender' (P6) - and Elijah Hill (70.6/299), who led C-USA with 9 sacks as a freshman.
Interior is thinner tape: Kamari Burns (68.6/174, Cincinnati) and Ramsey (54.8/137, Kentucky) = 'limited experience but P4' (P6); PS: 'completely rebuilt... bigger upside on the edge.'
45 = fringe-below-average from the 26th-pctile as-played base: real edge upside, unproven interior.

rationale_bullets: The top two are gone: Desmond Purnell (66.1/728, #1 tackler) graduated and 2x All-B12 Austin Romaine (76.5/517) -> Texas Tech.
Mekhi Mason (66.7/679) arrives with All-CUSA volume (12 starts, 68 tackles at Louisiana Tech); Gabe Powers (63.0/189) and Asa Newsom return; sophomore Darien Whitaker 'has drawn big reviews' (P6).
PS's 'won't fall off much' is opinion against the tape's top-end loss (Romaine was the roster's best defender). 44 = below average, cushioned by verified volume.

The corner tandem is the case: all-league Zashon Rich (68.6/837) + Donovan McIntosh (67.0/470), who entered the portal and withdrew (override recorded; on Athlon's May depth chart, P6-explicit returning starter) - PS: 'very talented secondary, led by a corner tandem.'
Losses are real: VJ Payne (73.3/722, #7 DC) graduated, Maldonado expired, Qua Moss (68.2/513) -> Tennessee, Daniel Cobbs -> Baylor.
Adds bring tape: Ja'Son Prevard (71.8/585, 3rd-team ACC at Virginia), Koy Beasley (71.3/647), Adrian Maddox (UGA 'spring hero' - P6); PS projects 'near the top 25' PDR.
52 = average-plus: verified tandem + tape-real adds against safety turnover.
Both legs return: K Luis Rodriguez (13-15 FG as the new kicker) and P Simon McClannan (42.5 avg / 39.2 net, 39 touchbacks on 70 kickoffs).
PS: 'all but [KR] Noemberg back so will be a typical KSt ST unit' - the program's ST tradition is a persistent edge; depth adds Hammond (Toledo) and Davidson.
As-played SPEC 68th pctile with everything back: 55 = above average, short of elite because the '25 unit itself wasn't.
